name: Yuki Furu Kisetsu e ~Omoi, Anata ni~
original_name: 雪降る季節へ ～想い、あなたに～
source:
Shinichiro Sawaki is a friendly and sincere boy. All the girls in school think about him this way, but noone made a move to know him better.
Transfer student Naomi Sakura comes to such class and sits next to hero. Naomi has great appearance, excellent grades and is good in sports, so she's very popular with boys. She gets familiar with the hero and that makes other girls in the class think of him in romance sense. Who will he date this winter?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
